title: Sequence Of Start And Config Reload
body:
Hi, 

I will like to clarify if there is already a solution/procedure for the following points:

- EPC mode: For the Open5gs PODs to come up properly without restarts, is there a recommended way of starting the EPC components e.g. Start HSS first then MME... 

Output when the PODs are finally stable:

```
[ec2-user@ip-10-0-0-53 ~]$ kubectl -n open5gs get po
NAME                                       READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
open5gs-hss-deployment-6cbb58cb68-dpltp    1/1     Running   3          67m
open5gs-mme-deployment-7fcdbf457b-7xdvr    1/1     Running   5          67m
open5gs-nrf-deployment-57d6678866-sv4tc    1/1     Running   0          67m
open5gs-pcrf-deployment-dc495b9b9-kq7g6    1/1     Running   4          67m
open5gs-sgwc-deployment-859b769979-s2nl7   1/1     Running   4          67m
open5gs-sgwu-deployment-7ccdc4bf9f-4466z   1/1     Running   0          67m
open5gs-smf-deployment-55467678b6-nzz8g    1/1     Running   4          67m
open5gs-upf-deployment-6fb795ccfd-wktjk    1/1     Running   0          67m
open5gs-webui-67d48c8ddf-c4b8z             1/1     Running   0          67m
```
So I think the PODs that are restarting are dependent on another component before everything runs smoothly.
This is not the case with 5G mode since the only pre-requisite component is the NRF

- Is config reload something that can be done without restarting the whole POD? Can the software daemons detect config change and do a reload?

- Is it possible for the SMF to start without specifying the UPF address? A sample scenario for this will be in a edge case where SMF is running in a central cloud and UPF runs in edge locations, so that SMF PFCP will start in server-mode and the UPF can connect to the SMF as they are created without re-configuring/restarting the SMF?
